Extend export command with CSV projection, configurable delimiter, null rendering, and shared schema.

# Completed

# Current Objective

Extend export command with CSV projection, configurable delimiter, null rendering, and shared schema.

# Completed

- Current implementation has cli.export_rows opening destination before writer work; CSV header and row mapping are fixed; JSON independently maps positional fields; schema.FIELDS exists.
- Added CLI flags and extended export_rows while retaining default call behavior.
- CSV validates delimiter and columns before destination open, projects schema fields in requested order, renders only None using null_text, and uses csv.writer quoting.
- CSV and JSON share schema.FIELD_INDEX/project_row; JSON ignores CSV-only options.
- Ran python -m unittest -v successfully (6 tests).

# Decisions

- Add shared field metadata/mapping in schema, validate CSV options before opening destination, and keep JSON ignoring CSV-only options so malformed CSV config cannot affect it.
- CSV option validation occurs in cli.export_rows before Path.open; JSON bypasses CSV validation entirely to preserve its output even with malformed CSV-only flags.

# Next Suggested Step

Work complete; inspect diff or commit as desired.
